name: Xuchang Yuandong Drive Shaft Co.Ltd
summary: Xuchang Yuandong Drive Shaft Co.Ltd, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the research, development, production, and sale of transmission drive shafts and related components in China and internationally. The company offers non-constant speed transmission shafts comprising four series of heavy-duty, medium-duty, light-duty, and engineering machinery, which are used in commercial vehicles, engineering machinery, such as loaders and cranes, special vehicles, etc. It also offers constant velocity drive shafts, which are used in passenger cars.
